definitions.name: O3B.BVALS
definitions.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 BC '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to Vector of +1 for each opener and -1 for each closer

definitions.name: O3B.PASS
definitions.note: one pass deleting every adjacent () and [] pair from a String

definitions.name: O3B.RED
definitions.body: O3B.PASS O3B.PASS O3B.PASS O3B.PASS O3B.PASS O3B.PASS
definitions.note: bracket String of at most 12 characters reduced to what remains after deleting matched pairs until none is left

definitions.name: O3B.BAL
definitions.note: TRUE when a bracket String is balanced (reduces to empty)

definitions.name: O3B.EQSTARTS
definitions.body: 'EV' BIND 0 EV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'EI' BIND EI 0 EQ NOT EV EI GET EV EI 1 SUB GET SUB 'ED' BIND ED ED MUL 0 GT NOT AND NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers to the indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts

definitions.name: O3B.UPSTARTS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND 0 UV LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'UI' BIND UI 0 EQ NOT UV UI GET UV UI 1 SUB GET SUB 0 GT AND NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers to the indices where a strictly increasing stretch starts

definitions.name: O3B.LENS
definitions.body: 'LN' BIND 'LS' BIND LS 1 DROP LN 1 COLLECT CONCAT LS SUB
definitions.note: start-index Vector and total length n to the Vector of run lengths (next start, or n, minus start)

definitions.name: O3B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MN' BIND MS MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle ones when the count is even)

definitions.name: O3B.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number or element-wise of a Vector of numbers
